name: Mirkfallon Lake
summary: In the Stonetalon Mountains, Mirkfallon Lake fills a basin beneath Windshear Crag. Native wildlife crowds its waters and banks, from aggressive slimes to thunder lizards and wyverns.

sections.title: A Highland Basin
sections.body: Mirkfallon Lake lies at the center of the Stonetalon range, between the passes to Webwinder Path in the south and Stonetalon Peak in the north. Runoff from the highlands feeds its waters, drawing thunder lizards down to drink and wyverns from their high roosts. Strange slimes bubble in the lake, making the crossing hazardous for travelers.

sections.title: Crossroads of the Crag
sections.body: Paths cross the lake basin in every direction. To the east, rocky tracks climb into Windshear Crag and the logging operations deep in its forested valleys. North of the lake, travelers climb toward night elven sanctums and tauren heights. Southward, the route skirts venomous spider hollows. Explorers and scouts crossing the contested mountains must reckon with the shifting dangers around the lake.

faq.q: What creatures live around Mirkfallon Lake?
faq.answer: Thunder lizards roam the banks, noxious ooze slimes inhabit the shallows, and mountain wyverns hunt around the basin and nest in the heights overhead.
Northward, the route climbs toward Stonetalon Peak. Southward, it descends through Webwinder Path, while rocky tracks to the east wind up into Windshear Crag.

faq.q: Is Mirkfallon Lake safe to fish in?
faq.answer: Sagefish and floating salvage tempt anglers, but aggressive slimes and wyverns frequent the shoreline and make quiet fishing difficult.

angles.text: As a druid, you see wild beasts around Mirkfallon Lake in a delicate balance, uncomfortably close to the mechanical axes advancing in the crag above.
